instruments.name: Arp Blip
instruments.description: A 25% pulse that snaps shut almost at once, made for fast chip arpeggios that fake a chord.

instruments.name: Glide Lead
instruments.description: A single-note filtered sawtooth that slides between notes, for expressive solos and bends.

instruments.name: FM Brass
instruments.description: A one-to-one FM tone whose overtones swell in with the note, the classic synth brass stab.

instruments.name: 8-Bit Square
instruments.description: A bare square wave straight off the oscillator with no filter and no envelope shaping, the way Online Sequencer plays it.

instruments.name: Triangle Bass
instruments.description: The soft, round triangle bass of the NES, with a short release so lines stay tight.

instruments.name: Acid Bass
instruments.description: A squelchy, resonant sawtooth with a snapping filter and glide, in the spirit of the TB-303.

instruments.name: Warm Strings
instruments.description: A detuned sawtooth ensemble behind a slowly opening lowpass, like a string machine section.

instruments.name: Electric Piano
instruments.description: A mellow FM body plus a quiet, high-ratio tine layer that pings on each strike, DX-style.

instruments.name: Drawbar Organ
instruments.description: Sine and triangle stops an octave below, at, and above the note, held steady like a tonewheel organ.

instruments.name: K.K. Crooner
instruments.description: The original: warm nah-me-oh-now-queh with a lazy swoop into every note.

instruments.name: Chip Kit
instruments.description: A whole chiptune drum machine in one instrument: kick, snare, clap, hats, toms, crash, and cowbell on the General MIDI drum notes, with the closed hat choking the open one.
